serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Groupize provides a unified platform to manage meetings, events, and group travel logistics across government agencies, contractors, and the travel management companies that support them. Groupize integrates with SAP Concur and delivers group travel authorization workflows aligned to agency policy. Additionally, Groupize offers meeting sourcing and room block management that bring rate visibility and per diem controls, and centralized dashboards that give real-time oversight of travelers, itineraries, and spend. Groupize supports everything from routine group travel to large-scale mobilizations—meetings, surge travel, field operations, and emergency travel—across distributed and cross-border programs.
